title: Contact frogsdream About Printables, Bugs or the Pack
metaDescription: Email frogsdream with a question, a theme idea, a printing problem, a Mega Pack refund or a privacy request. We usually reply within a few days.
intro: The best way to reach us is by email. We read every message and usually reply within a few days.

sections.heading: Things we can help with
sections.body:
* **Something prints wrongly.** Tell us which tool or theme page you used, your paper size, and your browser and device (for example, Chrome on a Chromebook). If you can, paste the share link from the tool so we can see the exact sheet.
* **A word list has a mistake.** Spelling slips, items that don't suit the age group, or a missing word that everybody expects. We are glad to fix these.
* **Ideas for new themes.** Holidays, classroom topics or party types you'd like to see.
* **Mega Pack questions, refunds and complaints.** Include the email address you used at checkout and, if you have it, the order number from your receipt. We answer complaints within 14 days; the [terms](/terms/#complaints) explain how they work. Questions about the payment itself can also go to Link, the Stripe service that sold you the pack, from your receipt email.
* **Privacy requests.** Questions about your data or a request to see, correct or delete it. See the [privacy policy](/privacy/) for what we hold, which for most visitors is nothing.

sections.heading: Before you write
body: A few quick fixes solve most printing problems:

* Check that the paper size in the tool (Letter or A4) matches the paper in your printer.
* In the print dialog, set scale to 100% or Default, and turn off headers and footers.
* If a long word looks squeezed, try a smaller grid or fewer cards per page.
* If Download PDF does nothing, give it a moment on a slow connection, or press Print and choose Save as PDF as the printer instead.
Our [printing tips guide](/guides/printing-tips-letter-vs-a4/) goes into more detail.

sections.heading: What we can't do
sections.body: We can't make custom designs to order, and we don't accept sponsored posts or paid links. frogsdream is a small independent project, so there is no phone line or live chat, just the inbox above.
